Author: ssalazar217 (SteSE)
Name: EchoXIV
Description:
EchoXIV is a chat translation tool for FFXIV. It translates both incoming and outgoing chat messages so you can communicate more naturally with players who use other languages.
Key Features:
- Bidirectional chat translation for incoming and outgoing messages.
- Configurable reading and writing languages.
- Multiple translation engines (Google, Papago, LibreTranslate, Yandex, Local AI) with configurable fallback and automatic primary recovery.
- Integrated Dalamud chat window for translated messages.

[Español]
EchoXIV es una herramienta de traducción de chat para FFXIV. Traduce mensajes entrantes y salientes para que puedas comunicarte de forma más natural con jugadores que usan otros idiomas.
Características:
- Traducción bidireccional para mensajes entrantes y salientes.
- Idiomas de lectura y escritura configurables.
- Múltiples motores de traducción (Google, Papago, LibreTranslate, Yandex, IA local) con respaldo configurable y recuperación automática del principal.
- Ventana integrada de Dalamud para mensajes traducidos.
Punchline: Bidirectional chat translation in Dalamud with auto-failover. / Traducción bidireccional de chat en Dalamud con failover automático.
Changelog:
v1.0.2.1:
- Added configurable maximum response tokens for AI engine instances, with a default of 500.
- Added support for multiple configurable instances of the same translation engine.
- Improved primary engine selection and instance management.
- Removed the redundant engine selector from the General tab.
- Improved configuration persistence and instance preservation during loading.
- Removed conversation-context translation processing to keep requests independent and efficient.
- Kept LibreTranslate as a standalone configurable translation engine.

v1.0.2.0:
- Added LibreTranslate and Yandex translation engines.
- Added expanded Local AI support for OpenAI-compatible servers such as LM Studio and Ollama.
- Added configurable translation-engine fallback with automatic primary recovery.
- Added single-request AI romanization with structured JSON responses.
- Improved translated-chat display and Papago integration.
